I think it would be used often.

It could be worked around (as shown above in my example code) **_IF_** the user properly understands how 3D vector math works.

I'm quite familiar with 3D math and it still took me a while to figure out this simple formula. Imagine someone who isn't.

This would be a useful tool to alleviate mental 3D math workload. The same way we have a bunch of 3D helper functions who are kinda redundant, but still useful.

I think we should be able to do this without understanding or thinking about the underlying vector math.
